scripts.build:core: npm run build:core:frontend && npm run build:core:go
scripts.build:plugins: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @reassembly/registry-plugin
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:plugins && npm --prefix manager/frontend run build
scripts.build:app: npm run build:plugins && cd manager && wails build
scripts.check: npm run build:plugins && npm --prefix manager/frontend run build && npm run build:go
scripts.test:core: npm run test:core:frontend && npm run test:core:go
scripts.test:plugins: npm run test:core && npm run test --workspace @reassembly/registry-plugin
scripts.test: npm run test:plugins && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:go
